title: 1467 platform-type-id vs platform-type-name
body: Fixes #1467 - move away from storing platform-type-name and force-name, and move towards storing platform-type-id and force-id

issues.title: Can't rename platform-type (introduce uniqid for platform-types)
issues.body:
We currently use `platformType.name` as value in `asset.platformType`.  But, if we rename the platform type, it will make the value of `asset.platformType` invalid.

So, we need to introduce `uniqid` for platformType. That's what will be stored in `asset.platformType`.  It will allow us to rename the platform type without breaking the data.

I expect changes in these areas:
- create platform type
- how list of platform-types is created in forces\assets
- handling of platform-type in mapping component

We'll probably need a workaround to make legacy data continue to work:
- add new field `platformTypeId`
- first check data for `platformTypeId`, if not present then work with `platformType`
- modify `findPlatformTypeFor` to take an extra parameter - the id.

Also, we should implement "cascading delete" for when a platform-type is deleted.  Any assets of that platform type should be deleted, too. (as reported in #1462 )

* [ ] clarify places where we store `forceId` not `force.name`.
* [ ] drop `Perception.type` (but keep type-id)
